_provenance: Wave sets and reinforcements: the RSProx capture analysis section 1.1 (every completed wave, identical to the LlemonDuck/fortis-colosseum community table). Every wave 1-11 spawns the warband trio (plus one extra under Quartet); reinforcements are added on wave tick 66. Coordinates are region local (template world minus 1792, 3072), the frame live capture uses. Gates (capture section 1.2, 69/69 waves): all of a wave's reinforcements come from the north gate (y 48, world z 3120) when the player's y at the start of tick 66 is 34 or more (world z 3106), else the south gate (y 20, world z 3092), at x 31 to 33 (world 1823 to 1825), distinct for each and random (traces: the jaguar on 31, 31, 33, 31, 31, 32 and the shaman on 33 twice; the model takes 31 then 33). Pillars (capture section 5f): x 24..26 and 39..41 by y 26..28 and 41..43. The arena box is colosim's 34 by 34 frame offset by (16, 18).
_reinforcementTickSrc: capture: reinforcements are added on wave tick 66 exactly; the pack spawns them in the housekeeping of the tick before this value (t + 1 >= 67), stamping spawn tick 66 (V2 pipeline.json)
_spawnsSrc: capture section 1.2 (451 waves): the shaman, javelin, manticore and shockwave each take one of twelve spawn points (SW tiles) at random, no point twice, from the points at least 5 tiles (Chebyshev) from the player's tile; the trio is a fixed formation, the berserker at B uniform over x 29..35 by y 34..40 with the archer at B+(-1,-1) and the seer at B+(+1,-1), and a Quartet member at B+(0,-2). Only the synthetic boards (headless harness, modifier advisor) use these; live spawns come from observation
